other_conditions: Candidate must be a domicile (permanent resident) of Tripura
Candidate must have cleared the Civil Services Examination Prelims conducted by UPSC
Candidate can receive assistance only twice, irrespective of the number of attempts
benefits_summary: ₹1,00,000 for candidates clearing UPSC Prelims (coaching and travel expenses) and ₹20,000 for candidates clearing UPSC Mains and invited for interview, both disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
